prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Atlanta for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for implants — the right provider depends on your needs (single tooth vs full-arch, bone grafting needed, sedation preference, budget, insurance, etc.). I can help you find an excellent implant specialist in Atlanta if you tell me a few things first.

What I recommend and can look for:
- Type of specialist you prefer: oral & maxillofacial surgeon, periodontist, or prosthodontist (oral surgeons/periodontists place implants; prosthodontists specialize in implant restorations).
- Your ZIP code or neighborhood in Atlanta (to find nearby providers).
- Any insurance or budget limits.
- Complexity of your case (e.g., single implant, multiple implants, bone graft/sinus lift).
- Sedation needs or medical concerns.

What to look for when choosing a provider:
- Specialty training and board certification (ABOMS for oral surgeons, American Board of Periodontology, American Board of Prosthodontics).
- Substantial implant experience and before/after photos.
- Use of 3D imaging (CBCT) and guided implant planning.
- Positive patient reviews and clear explanations of risks, costs, and alternatives.
- Willingness to coordinate with a prosthodontist if needed.

If you want, give me your ZIP code and a couple of preferences and I’ll find top-rated implant specialists in Atlanta and summarize credentials, patient ratings, and contact info. Which details would you like me to use?
